resources.string: The client is using multiple AndMTProto proxy entries in Telegram, or some entries are outdated. Please remove the redundant proxies in Telegram (Settings → Data and Storage → Proxy Settings) and disable “Auto-switch proxies”. Then restart Telegram: until then it keeps checking the deleted entries. This card goes away about 10 minutes after the last rejected connection.
Telegram is not installed. Copy the link instead.
Battery optimisation may stop the proxy in the background. In the list that opens, find AndMTProto and turn optimisation off for it (if it isn’t listed, switch the list to all apps).

On Xiaomi (MIUI / HyperOS) the system may stop the proxy in the background. Tap “Allow background work”, pick AndMTProto, open its background activity control and choose “No restrictions”. If the card stays although it’s set, tap “Done”.
Autostart is off for AndMTProto, so the proxy can’t start with the phone or come back after the system stops it. Tap the button below and turn on Autostart for AndMTProto.
Turn on Autostart for AndMTProto, or the proxy can’t start with the phone or come back after the system stops it. The app can’t check this setting on this phone, so tap “Done” once it’s on.
Port %1$s is already used by another app.
No permission to listen on port %1$s.
Address %1$s is not available on this device.
The secret must be 32 hex characters.
Invalid DC → IP line: “%1$s”. Use DC:IP, e.g. 4:149.154.167.220.
“%1$s” is not a valid Fake TLS domain.
Not 127.0.0.1: other devices on your network (for example, public Wi-Fi) can connect to the proxy, and anyone who learns the secret can use your connection. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you need this.
If photos or videos don\'t load, leave only 4:149.154.167.220 or clear the field.
Use my own CF proxy domains
If media or some channels load slowly, the shared CF proxy is probably overloaded. Your own free Cloudflare Worker, or your own CF domain, fixes this.
You have %1$s. Tap to open the release page.
Telegram opens a proxy dialog: tap “Connect proxy”. This card collapses by itself once Telegram connects.
Open or copy the link again from the ⋮ menu.
Changes are saved when you leave Settings; a running proxy restarts with them.

Telegram keeps connecting, but nothing gets through the current network, even after an automatic restart of the proxy. Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, or turn airplane mode on and off. On mobile data your own CF Worker (Settings → Route) is more reliable than the shared CF domains.
You have %1$s. Open the release page to download the APK.
Use it to add the proxy to Telegram again, or send the link to yourself in Saved Messages.
